title: Families of Maguindanao massacre victims renew call for justice 17 years after killings

blocks.text: Relatives of victims in the 2009 Maguindanao massacre in the Philippines are joined by the new chief justice in marking the seventeenth anniversary of the killings. They called for a swift resolution of pending cases in the country's worst incident of election-related violence.
